summary: Keep GitHub observer refusals on real cooldowns and distinguish local observer budgets

replay.detail: Repeated provider refusals persist their latest next-check deadline instead of retaining the first reset. Existing observer claims remain readable; no replay or backfill is required.

schema.detail: Adds observer.state enum value throttled for non-fault local admission deferral. No tables, indexes or migrations. A separate optional budget-history JSON sidecar retains bounded 48-hour resource-specific provider header samples; the authoritative admission ledger is unchanged.

rules.detail: Only future GitHub Retry-After/reset deadlines are accepted; absent a future deadline, primary and secondary limits wait fifteen minutes. The per-daemon observer cap is unchanged and is classified as a local refusal, not GitHub HTTP 429. Each same-origin REST redirect hop is separately admitted; cross-origin redirects are refused, and implicit transport retries are disabled in observer and authorized gateway clients.

compatibility.detail: Local observer refusals emit state throttled, error_code local-observer-budget, and a local next-slot reason; GitHub watch views expose throttled and its next deadline. New readers accept all previous states. Older claim registries may reject throttled receipts; fleet readers must understand the new enum before relying on cross-version receipt replay. Budget-history sidecars are diagnostic and ignored by older binaries.

manual.detail: Coordinate fleet readers to accept throttled observer receipts; do not assume a pre-change registry can replay new receipts. No live config changes; the cap remains per daemon, not fleet-wide.

recovery.detail: Use a forward fix or a rollback reader that accepts throttled observer receipts; a pre-change registry may reject the new enum. Do not delete authoritative observer history to force rollback. The diagnostic budget sidecar does not control admission.
